Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

Thames Valley Police recorded 90 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 4.6 per 1,000 residents, the 22nd highest rate of Oxford's 24 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (4), bicycle theft (3), vehicle crime (1); the evening/night score by violent crime (10), public order (2), anti social behaviour (2). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Summertown safe?

Wandroz currently rates Summertown in Oxford as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Oxford, both by day and after dark. This rating is derived from Thames Valley Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Summertown safe at night?

At night, Summertown is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Oxford. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Summertown a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Summertown's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Oxford) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
